snippet.title: PRIGOD IDLE - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Prigod Idle is an idle autobattler where the build does the fighting.

Choose a build and send your hero to battle. Gear, gems, relics and enchants. Four tech
trees with thousands of paths. 20+ heroes, 25 artifacts, 95 relics, 23 Fables and 47 pets.
Special bosses with unique mechanics: if you lose, try a different approach and outbuild
them. Or go full auto and let the run pick its own route. Play it full-screen or as a
desktop companion beside your work.

Coming to Steam and Android on 4 November 2026. Pay once, no microtransactions.

Free demo out now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5091900/Prigod_Idle/

Website: https://prigodgames.de
TikTok: @prigodgames
